en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a brick railway station complex with several connected buildings, a forecourt with people standing and a horse-drawn cart, and a tram or streetcar in the right foreground. There is handwritten purple ink text across the sky area. Printed red text at the top left reads "Graz." and at the top right "Staatsbahnhof.", with a small printed serial number at the bottom left.
